channel.title: Robinson Vidva - Articles
channel.description: Articles on computational biology, drug repositioning, research tools, and scientific innovation by Robinson Vidva.

item.title: Drug Repositioning Through Computational Modeling: A Practitioner's Perspective
item.description: Exploring how computational modeling and network-based methods accelerate the discovery of new therapeutic uses for existing drugs — from cancer combination therapies to inflammatory disease treatment.

item.title: MyVivarium: Streamlining Lab Animal Colony Management
item.description: An open-source, cloud-based application for managing research animal colonies with IoT-based environmental monitoring. Published in Computational and Structural Biotechnology Journal.
